# glinet_firewall_forwarding (Resource)

Manage one firewall forwarding between zones. Identity is `src:dest`; destroy releases ownership by default.

## Import existing configuration

1. Use the example’s resource block and match its arguments to the current router settings. Explicitly set values that differ from the defaults.
2. Add the import block below with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_firewall_forwarding.guest_to_wan
  id = "guest:wan"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_firewall_forwarding" "guest_to_wan" {
  src     = "guest"
  dest    = "wan"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dest` (String) Destination zone.
- `src` (String) Source zone.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the forwarding is active.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
